beats.asset_note: The subject itself: lead company logo card / product visual / thumbnail metaphor image. On screen inside the first 2 seconds.
beats.motion_detail: Logo card spring-settles; headline claim builds word-group by word-group as spoken.
beats.name: Hook
beats.narration_job: Dated facts -> contradiction/stakes -> promise. No greeting, no channel intro, no sponsor before the promise. Subject named immediately.

beats.asset_note: Contender lineup: each named contender's logo card appears as it is named; test/checklist card builds item by item.
beats.motion_detail: Cards settle in sequence; checklist items pop in as spoken.
beats.name: Setup / decoder
beats.narration_job: What will be tested/checked and against what; decode jargon names before evidence starts.

beats.asset_note: Priority: real proof full-screen with cited text highlighted as spoken > chart > generated visualisation of the claim > generated motion clip (metaphor) > logo card (beat about the company itself).
beats.motion_detail: Popups, underlines, circles land on the cited element exactly as spoken; comma/list changes appear as spoken. No slow zoom.
beats.name: Proof beat (repeats per contender/item)
beats.narration_job: Claim -> evidence -> what it means. Identical beat shape per contender (mirrored lattice). Update format: one feature per beat, <= ~60s each.

beats.asset_note: Proof of the failure/limit where one exists; price/limit as chart; else a generated image visualising the limit.
beats.motion_detail: The one deliberately different motion of the video: glimmer sweep reverses, headline settles slower.
beats.name: The catch
beats.narration_job: What breaks, what it costs, where the claim fails — the honest catch as its own named beat, placed late-middle.

beats.asset_note: Verdict table: one row per contender — logo + job + one-line verdict; rows light up as spoken.
beats.motion_detail: Rows build one by one; recommended row gets the gold highlight sweep.
beats.name: Payoff / verdict by job
beats.narration_job: Verdict split by job/use — never a single overall winner. Cost per task lives inside the row it belongs to.

beats.asset_note: Checklist card; every item carries a mini visual of the thing it names (logo chip / proof thumbnail) — the no-text-only rule applies here too.
beats.motion_detail: Items build in one by one under a moving gold highlight.
beats.name: What you can do (checklist close)
beats.narration_job: The reusable artefact: checklist / cheat sheet / sizing rule the viewer can screenshot.

beats.asset_note: Ctrl-Ahead brass-arrow brand mark, full-screen. No new information after the catchphrase; end card holds >= 1.5s.
beats.motion_detail: Brand mark spring-settles with a single glimmer pass.
beats.name: Outro
beats.narration_job: Welcome first-time viewers, subscribe push, catchphrase.

engine.animation: GSAP (CustomEase butter curves, spring where specified)

format_variants.analysis: 12-15 min. Proof sections may run 3-5 min only while the visual keeps changing at headline/proof level. Decoder beat mandatory.
format_variants.comparison: 7-13 min. Proof beats form the mirrored lattice (same asset order and motion, contender swap only). Verdict table mandatory.
format_variants.setup_build: Proof beats become numbered steps; the result step is the longest; catch beat becomes the mistake-to-avoid step.
format_variants.update: 5-7 min. Proof beats <= 60s each; catch may merge into the last proof beat's tail but must be named in narration.

hard_rules.logo_rule: Every company/product named in the script gets a logo_card or product visual on screen at its first mention.
hard_rules.proof_rule: Proof beats use the real document/output full-screen with cited text highlighted as spoken (mouthfeed). Generated media is metaphor/atmosphere only, never proof.
hard_rules.script_purity: Narration covers only the topic/concept and Oliver's opinions about it. No production process, receipts/provenance, pipeline, or video-attribute talk; no obedience-to-directions presented as reasoning. Exception: the pipeline itself is the topic.
hard_rules.visual_coverage: Every narration beat gets a visual that shows what is being talked about. Words + word animation alone is not a visual. Max text-only stretch: 4s (one caption line).

music.level: felt, not heard (~10-15% of voiceover level)
music.note: Beat timing follows the narration clock, never the music.
music.source: Suno-generated instrumental bed (selected per AheadOfBeat rights rule)
